headline.purpose: The single page h1 and no other element.

operational.purpose: Age, table codes and dense secondary facts.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Rare low separation without a wide decorative blur.

shadows.name: docked
shadows.purpose: Mobile actions docked above scrolling content.

shadows.name: elevated
shadows.purpose: Dialogs, menus and temporary overlays only.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Focus, hover, selection and state feedback. Reduced motion is instant.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: One dominant verb-object action in the current task region.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 16px; background: var(--color-brand-600, oklch(0.55 0.16 37)); color: white; font: 600 14px/1.25 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--color-brand-700, oklch(0.47 0.14 35)); } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus, oklch(0.55 0.16 37)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Context Header
components.description: Scope, title, status and one action without an ornamental eyebrow.
components.html:
Northwind / Old Town

Dining room

12 active tables · dinner service
components.css: .ds-context-header { display:flex; align-items:flex-start; justify-content:space-between; gap:16px; padding-block:8px 20px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-border-subtle, oklch(0.9 0.008 75)); color:var(--color-text-primary, oklch(0.21 0.018 45)); } .ds-context-header h1 { margin:6px 0 4px; font:600 24px/1.25 'Instrument Sans',sans-serif; letter-spacing:-0.02em; } .ds-context-header p,.ds-context-path { margin:0; color:var(--color-text-muted, oklch(0.48 0.025 45)); font:500 14px/1.35 'Instrument Sans',sans-serif; } .ds-context-header button { min-height:44px; border:0; border-radius:10px; padding:10px 16px; background:var(--color-brand-600, oklch(0.55 0.16 37)); color:white; font-weight:600; } .ds-context-header button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-focus, oklch(0.55 0.16 37)); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Priority Row
components.description: Scan-friendly operational subject, state and next action.
components.css: .ds-priority-row { min-height:56px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; padding:12px; border:1px solid var(--color-border-subtle, oklch(0.9 0.008 75)); border-radius:10px; background:var(--color-surface, white); color:var(--color-text-primary, oklch(0.21 0.018 45)); } .ds-priority-row div { min-width:0; display:grid; gap:3px; } .ds-priority-row strong { font:600 15px/1.3 'Instrument Sans',sans-serif; } .ds-priority-row span { color:var(--color-text-muted, oklch(0.48 0.025 45)); font:500 13px/1.35 'Instrument Sans',sans-serif; } .ds-priority-row button { min-height:44px; border:0; border-radius:10px; padding:8px 12px; background:var(--color-brand-600, oklch(0.55 0.16 37)); color:white; font-weight:600; } .ds-priority-row:focus-within { border-color:var(--color-brand-600, oklch(0.55 0.16 37)); }

components.name: Workspace Split
components.description: Desktop queue plus detail with structural separation rather than nested cards.
components.html:
Priority queueTable 12 · 7 minTable 4 · 3 min
Table 12

Review the guest draft before sending it to fulfilment.
components.css: .ds-workspace { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(260px,0.8fr) minmax(360px,1.2fr); min-height:220px; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid var(--color-border-subtle, oklch(0.9 0.008 75)); border-radius:14px; background:var(--color-surface,white); color:var(--color-text-primary,oklch(0.21 0.018 45)); } .ds-workspace-list,.ds-workspace-detail { display:grid; align-content:start; gap:12px; padding:16px; } .ds-workspace-list { background:var(--color-surface-muted,oklch(0.97 0.004 85)); border-right:1px solid var(--color-border-subtle,oklch(0.9 0.008 75)); } .ds-workspace span { padding:10px 12px; border-radius:10px; background:var(--color-surface,white); } .ds-workspace p { max-width:52ch; margin:0; color:var(--color-text-muted,oklch(0.48 0.025 45)); }

components.name: State Panel
components.description: A recoverable empty or error state that teaches the next step.
components.html:
No tables need attention

New calls and drafts will appear here automatically.
components.css: .ds-state { display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:12px; padding:20px 0; color:var(--color-text-primary,oklch(0.21 0.018 45)); } .ds-state svg { width:24px; height:24px; flex:none; color:var(--color-brand-600,oklch(0.55 0.16 37)); } .ds-state div { display:grid; gap:4px; } .ds-state strong { font:600 16px/1.35 'Instrument Sans',sans-serif; } .ds-state p { max-width:60ch; margin:0; color:var(--color-text-muted,oklch(0.48 0.025 45)); font:400 14px/1.5 'Instrument Sans',sans-serif; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Visible label, readable helper text and explicit focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:8px; color:var(--color-text-primary,oklch(0.21 0.018 45)); font:600 14px/1.25 'Instrument Sans',sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height:44px; border:1px solid var(--color-border-subtle,oklch(0.9 0.008 75)); border-radius:10px; padding:10px 12px; background:var(--color-surface,white); color:var(--color-text-primary,oklch(0.21 0.018 45)); font:400 16px/1.5 'Instrument Sans',sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-focus,oklch(0.55 0.16 37)); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-field small { color:var(--color-text-muted,oklch(0.48 0.025 45)); font:400 13px/1.4 'Instrument Sans',sans-serif; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Named state with redundant icon and status-family colors.
components.html: Ready to serve
components.css: .ds-status { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; min-height:28px; border:1px solid var(--color-success-border,oklch(0.78 0.075 151)); border-radius:999px; padding:4px 9px; background:var(--color-success-surface,oklch(0.96 0.035 151)); color:var(--color-success,oklch(0.49 0.13 151)); font:600 13px/1.25 'Instrument Sans',sans-serif; } .ds-status svg { width:12px; height:12px; flex:none; }

components.name: Danger Confirmation
components.description: Consequence, reason field and safe cancel before a destructive action.
components.html:
Close this table?

The current session will close. Orders and payment history remain available.
components.css: .ds-confirm { max-width:440px; border-radius:16px; padding:20px; background:var(--color-surface-raised,white); color:var(--color-text-primary,oklch(0.21 0.018 45)); box-shadow:0 18px 50px oklch(0.21 0.018 45 / 0.16); font-family:'Instrument Sans',sans-serif; } .ds-confirm h2 { margin:0; font-size:18px; line-height:1.35; } .ds-confirm p { margin:8px 0 20px; color:var(--color-text-muted,oklch(0.48 0.025 45)); line-height:1.5; } .ds-confirm div { display:flex; justify-content:flex-end; gap:8px; } .ds-confirm button { min-height:44px; border-radius:10px; padding:9px 14px; font-weight:600; } .ds-cancel { border:1px solid var(--color-border-subtle,oklch(0.9 0.008 75)); background:var(--color-surface,white); color:inherit; } .ds-danger { border:0; background:var(--color-danger,oklch(0.51 0.19 27)); color:white; } .ds-confirm button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-focus,oklch(0.55 0.16 37)); outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview: Scope, urgency and the next hand-off stay visible without visual shouting. Guest, management and operational surfaces share one semantic language at densities appropriate to the task.

rules.name: The Active-Service Rule
rules.body: Use Service Clay for primary action, current selection and focus only.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Normal groups use spacing or one complete border; shadows represent real layering.

rules.name: The Translation-Expansion Rule
rules.body: Titles and actions wrap before they truncate.

dos: Do show scope, state and one next action within seconds.
Do verify 320px reflow, 200% zoom, keyboard, reduced motion and EN/LT/RU expansion.
Do keep mobile detail as a normal navigable page.
donts: Don't use side-stripe borders, gradient text or border-plus-wide-shadow ghost cards.
Don't build identical card grids or shrink desktop boards onto mobile.
Don't use color, badges or motion as decoration.
